_comment: Phase 2 acquisition criteria: which Florida DOR Property Use codes to include, exclude, or flag for review. Edit this file to change behavior -- no code changes needed. 'decisions' keys are the first 2 digits of the DOR code (e.g. property use '0100' -> prefix '01'). Any prefix not listed here and not covered by exclude_ranges defaults to 'default_decision' (review) -- an unrecognized code is never silently excluded OR silently included.
_comment_ranges: Two-digit prefix ranges, inclusive, that default to 'exclude' when not individually listed in decisions above -- commercial/industrial/agricultural/institutional/government/misc.

teardown_infill._comment: Signal only (a flag, not a score) -- see is_teardown_infill_candidate().
